text:
Plan all 24 Orchard modules. Final values supersede drafts.

Values: billing.max_workers=22; scheduler.timeout_s=50, retry_limit=9; backup.retry_limit=5; auth.retry_limit=3; export.timeout_s=75, retry_limit=7; ledger.retry_limit=6; sync.retry_limit=5; metrics.max_workers=14, batch_size=550; alerts.ttl_s=600; inventory.ttl_s=150; reports.batch_size=900; media.queue_depth=150; profile.queue_depth=340.

Minimums: media.timeout_s≥120, alerts.timeout_s≥120, notify.batch_size≥800, sync.ttl_s≥540, gateway.max_workers≥28, webhooks.batch_size≥850, reports.max_workers≥30. Maximum: audit.queue_depth≤30.

Alpha-only: notify, export, profile. Beta-only: webhooks, reports, sync, checkout, audit.
Co-locate: auth+catalog, export+upload, scheduler+tenant, alerts+media.
Separate: catalog/upload, media/upload, audit/backup, audit/scheduler, audit/sync.

Dependencies: billing→sync, quota→billing, archive→billing, profile→sync, shipping→ledger, shipping→checkout, media→scheduler, backup→quota.
Forbidden (transitive too): audit→billing, metrics→billing, backup→webhooks, metrics→alerts.
Order: reports before backup. Rollout: reports before gateway; checkout and webhooks before quota.

Files: worker.py→shipping, retry.py→alerts, loader.py→upload, serial.py→inventory, locks.py→export, types.py and hooks.py→archive, policy.py→billing.

Flag conflicts to me; don't resolve silently. Known: audit/sync must be separate, but both are beta-only.
